name: ECE M.S. (Spring 2027)
description: MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering — CIT Elective and General Technical Elective coursework for Spring 2027. Uses 300+ level ranges from Stellic audit.

categories.name: ECE Core
categories.description: 60 units of graduate coursework (600+) within ECE (18-XXX).
categories.notes: 18-601 through 18-606 and 18-700 through 18-703 cannot count toward ECE Core but may count toward CIT or General Technical Electives.

categories.name: CIT Elective
categories.description: 24 units from CIT departments (300-999 level). Up to 15 units of 18-980/18-981 project work.
categories.notes: 300-999 level from CIT depts. 18-980/18-981 project units capped at 15 each, max 1 course from 18-980/18-981 combined. Excluded courses may count toward General Technical Elective instead.

categories.name: General Technical Elective
categories.description: 12 units (300-999 level) from approved programs or individually approved courses.
categories.notes: 300-999 level from approved departments. Individually approved courses also listed. 53-XXX courses only count if taken before or during Spring 2026.

categories.name: Intro to Grad Studies
categories.description: 1 unit — must be taken in your first semester. Conflicts are not permitted.
categories.notes: 18-989 Introduction to Graduate Studies. Required first semester, no conflicts permitted.
